note: Maps company_bank_account.payment_means_code (UN/CEFACT payment means code list, UNCL4461 subset, the codes of STD_EN16931, BT-81) to the ISO 20022 payment method, service level and local instrument. The external code is a composite of those parts joined with plus signs: method, then service level, then local instrument. The payment apps split it. 30 and 58 map to a credit transfer (PmtMtd TRF, SvcLvl SEPA for 58). 49 and 59 map to a direct debit (PmtMtd DD, SvcLvl SEPA and LclInstrm CORE for 59). A SEPA business-to-business debit has no UNCL4461 code of its own (finding G-ISO-6): it needs a code added by the country package or the company

objects.external_text: SEPA credit transfer (PmtMtd TRF, SvcLvl SEPA)
SEPA Core direct debit (PmtMtd DD, SvcLvl SEPA, LclInstrm CORE)
